evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress on medical question-answering, yet effective medical dialogue also requires learning to ask questions that uncover relevant patient information.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Extensive experiments across four medical benchmarks demonstrate that PCQC achieves 63.10% mean diagnostic accuracy, outperforming GRPO and ATPO by 4.38 and 4.21 percentage points, respectively.
